signature: SEBASTIAN [master’s mark: cartouche with cock with tail spread, initials “S H”] HAINLEIN / 16. NVRM [master’s mark (extends through both lines of signature)] BERG  [on bell are engraved the three Nuremberg coats of arms with an undulating cord and two tassels]
dimensions: bo 10.2, be 105, le 2615, h 1075, bell sec. entry 14
literature: Wörthmüller 1955: 445; Langwill 1974: 69; Van der Meer 1979: 92, Abb. 147-48 (photos); Van der Meer 1982: 34; Van der Meer 1983: 142 (photo); Fischer 1984: 43; 300 Jahre 1985: 289 (photo); Huber 1989: 355.
remarks: Flat slide-stays, engraved with blossoms and tendrils and each with two dragon-head clasps. Some ferrules have simple ring pattern; some also have cast borders with leaf pattern; others have dragon-scale pattern in middle; still others have wreath with small half-sphere; still others have border with pointed teeth and round arches. One flat bell stay engraved with angel playing a trombone; eyelet off-center to bell-pipe side; sleeve adjacent to bell stay has engraved blossom on both sides; hinge plate adjacent to bell stay in leaf form with engraved leaf pattern. Ring in bell bow, mounted on leaf-shaped saddle engraved with zigzag pattern. Bell only slightly flared. Garland has cast rim wire with leaf design; engraved tooth pattern on inner border.
